nativeContract: Direct base construction can retain constructor function/template identity independently of current public prototype or constructor property.

Prototype-role and different-new-target cases use distinct rules; Reflect.construct with a different new.target can observe that prototype constructor data replacement.
Fallback accepts data string Symbol.toStringTag including empty string; it does not execute accessors. Named direct construction can take precedence over that tag.

Built-in kinds, foreign realms, frozen objects, empty/inferred names and objects used as prototypes need genuine engine metadata.
